name: Joeone Co.,Ltd
summary: Joeone Co.,Ltd produces and sells men's trousers and business casual clothing in China. The company offers men 's trousers, jackets, T- shirts, and suits under the Jiumuwang, ZIOZIA, and FUN brands. It sells its products through offline stores, as well as online platforms such as Tmall, JD.com, and WeChat stores. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Quanzhou, China. Joeone Co.,Ltd is a subsidiary of Jiu Muwang International Investment Holdings Co., Ltd.
